correctness.rationale: Derivation matrix derivation in characteristic two is directly verified; its faithful quotient action identifies square-zero and pairwise commutation with those of traceless 3x3 matrices. All nonzero square-zero 3x3 matrices are rank one, and their commuting tuples are exactly the common-image/common-kernel families. The rational line/plane/flag fibers have dimensions 2, 2 and 1, and the derivation-rank criterion depends on the fixed quotient line. Inclusion-exclusion proves every coefficient of the stated polynomial over arbitrary finite characteristic-two fields. Independent exhaustive matrix multiplication verifies the entire rank distribution for q=2,4,m=2 and q=2,m=3.

value.rationale: The theorem determines a complete multivariate rank invariant of pairwise-compatible square-zero differentials on a canonical modular group algebra, for arbitrary length and every finite even field. Rank 2 gives vanishing homology on the 4D algebra, so the coefficients encode exact simultaneous acyclicity profiles; the old geometric dimension results do not give this arithmetic data. The finite cases are natural checks rather than the contribution.
